title: Every raw input behind the derived scenery products
note: Cached under .tmp/venue-cache/ with a fetch log at .tmp/venue-cache/provenance/lidar-naip.tsv. A file on disk is never refetched, so a derivation replays with the network unplugged. Retrieval dates come from that log, never from a clock read during derivation.

osm.note: Overpass responses fetched by scripts/layline-bake-venue.mjs; the query text lives with the query in that file.

files.note: baker Q1: coastline, breakwater and crane ways/nodes over the clip disc + 1500 m
baker Q2: buildings with a height tag at or over MASS_MIN_H
baker Q5: hero anchors pinned by OSM id, plus the Signal Hill well cluster
